description: This file defines the CachingStream class, a stream decorator implementing caching for read bytes from a sequential stream, used within the GuzzleHttp PSR-7 library.

classes.name: CachingStream
classes.description: A stream decorator class that caches bytes read from a remote stream, allowing for efficient repeated reads and seeking.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the caching stream with a source stream and optional target stream for caching.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the stream, considering both the cache and remote stream.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the stream position to the beginning.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific position in the stream, handling different seek modes.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data from the stream, fetching from remote if necessary, and updates the cache.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data to the stream and manages skip bytes for overwriting.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the stream has reached end-of-file.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes both the remote and cache streams.

methods.name: cacheEntireStream
methods.description: Caches the entire remote stream into the buffer.
